_comment: Synthesized (Phase 20.4). A `data` array deliberately out of index order (2, 0, 1). OpenAI documents `data[].index` precisely because array order is not contractual, so `decode_response/4` sorts by `:index`. Each vector's first component encodes its index (0.20 / 0.00 / 0.10) so the wire test can assert the decoded order without relying on list position.
